item.title: Top 10 countdown: These are the most popular Texas state parks each spring
item.description: Across the Lone Star State, there are 85 state parks, natural areas and historic sites currently operated by the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department. But which gets the most visitors each spring?

item.title: Deadly Lakeway crash closes parts of Lohmans Crossing Road
item.description: Parts of Lohmans Crossing Road in Lakeway are shut down Monday night after a deadly crash, according to Lakeway Police.

item.title: Budget exercise flagged downtown EMS staffing for possible cuts before Sixth Street shooting
item.description: City leaders have repeatedly said first responder programs they had in place during the West Sixth Street shooting saved "countless, countless lives."

item.description: We're keeping track of all the numbers in what is set to be another busy year at AUS. Follow along with our interactive charts.

item.title: Arch Manning limited in 1st spring practice, Sarkisian said he's 'right on path' after surgery
item.description: Arch Manning was limited in Texas’ first spring practice as he continues recovering from offseason foot surgery, but Steve Sarkisian says the quarterback is on schedule and expected to ramp up as spring progresses.

item.title: Lakeway view fight: Height increase and tree dispute spark major neighborhood showdown
item.description: A 1.5‑foot home rebuild and a resident’s request for tree‑trimming rules have ignited a major fight in Lakeway over a 2011 ordinance meant to protect Lake Travis views.

item.title: VIDEO: Waymo vehicle stops in between train tracks, stop arm
item.description: A video circulating on social media shows a Waymo autonomous vehicle in Austin stopped in between train tracks and a railroad stop arm as a CapMetro train passes by.

item.title: Lawsuit names Austin mass shooter as Tesla employee accused in earlier assault
item.description: The lawsuit, filed March 5 in Travis County district court, alleges Tesla employee Ndiaga Diagne attacked a co-worker over 65 years old during a workplace break on Dec. 4, 2025.

item.title: Spotty shower today, but severe storms Tuesday night
item.description: A level 2 to 3 out of 5 severe weather risk is in the Hill Country Tuesday evening and night. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Woman convicted in baby's 2003 scalding death exonerated on 'basis of actual innocence' in Travis County court
item.description: Carmen Mejia was 34 in July 2003 when police said she brought a baby to a clinic on Lamar Blvd. with third-degree burns over 80% of his body.
